name: Christmas in McGregor
when_note: The parade starts at 6 pm, doors open at 6:30 pm and the tree lights at 6:45 pm.
paras: McGregor Christmas is a free family night on Friday, December 18, 2026, at The Exchange Event Center, 300 S Jefferson Ave. A Christmas parade down Main Street starts at 6 pm, and the tree lights at 6:45 pm.
Local sponsors pay for the evening, which includes pictures with Santa, crafts with Mrs. Claus, a petting zoo, train rides, carnival games and a Christmas movie on the lawn.
tip: The site says something new is coming to the Santa pictures this year.

name: Bellmead Christmas Tree Lighting and Parade
when_note: The city lists the tree lighting at 6:30 pm and the parade at 7 pm.
paras: Bellmead holds its annual tree lighting in Memorial Park, 3017 Bellmead Drive, on Thursday, December 3, 2026. The city lists the lighting at 6:30 pm and the parade at 7 pm.
The city calendar shows the evening starting at 6 pm, so families can arrive early and find a spot before the parade.
tip: The city calendar lists a 6 pm start, so plan to arrive early.
